hero.title: Pet-friendly rural bungalows in Villamanrique
hero.subtitle: Bungalows designed for rest and privacy in the heart of the La Mancha countryside. Pet-friendly.

intro: Finca Los Collados de San Miguel is a country house with eight pet-friendly bungalows in Villamanrique, Ciudad Real, in Campo de Montiel. We sleep up to 16 adults, with breakfast, Wi-Fi and a pool. Book on Booking.com or message us on WhatsApp.

capacity.title: Capacity
items: Up to 16 adults in the accommodation (8 bungalows)
Children possible, depending on the booking set-up
Ideal for small groups, families and companies
